hypothesis: At fixed existing encoder history, allowing encoder gradients under direct unordered membership supervision improves held-out membership relative to the same frozen encoder with the same 128-wide head.
changed_factor: encoder frozen versus adapted under the same direct unordered membership objective
control: Same Phase71 reference checkpoint in both arms, frozen PID parameters, a 128-wide head in both arms, identical initialization, train identities and optimizer presentations. No capacity or pretraining effect is claimed.
target_contract: two optional unordered source groups plus unassigned; membership-only target separate from exact retained hierarchy; report raw and constraint-accepted groups and target charge/source compatibility
data_and_compute_control: 384 original pilot training identities (64/category), 60 already-used development collisions (10/category), no Phase72 primary or selection use. Tiny head assay:24 training events,1000 updates,batch24. Main fit:1000 updates,batch16,seed20261008,head AdamW lr0.001; adapted encoder lr0.00005, frozen control no encoder gradients. Fixed final checkpoint and presence0.5; no early stopping or tuning. Two CPU-only tasks,2CPU/32GiB/24h each,no requeue. Report encoder forwards,node-pair workload,CPU/wall time,peak RSS,parameters; FLOPs unavailable and equal compute is not claimed.
stop_rule: Stop on nonfinite loss/gradients/parameters, absent adapted encoder gradient, PID parameter changes, source/cohort mismatch, or resource limit. Review both fixed final results even if negative. No fresh primary reservation, hierarchy, automatic follow-on, pretraining-duration or coefficient sweep.
success_rule: Before proposing primary or hierarchy require >=95% raw tiny membership plus positive collision-paired held-out accepted and raw exact-membership gain, with nominal and unavailable counts, no point increase in continuum accepted events, zero accepted source conflicts and explicit charge rejection accounting. Sparse40-B-trial development and one seed are exploratory and cannot establish population or physical FEI superiority.
validation_selection: Use already designated development identities, not the sealed test or Phase72 fresh primary/selection reservations. Preregister checkpoint selection and acceptance threshold on development; any later primary assessment needs a separately authenticated fresh cohort.
followup_if_negative: Test detector-pair within-B relation discrimination or explicit first-error correction after locating a measured failure; do not infer that all direct membership architectures are ineffective.
scope_note: This existing frozen-versus-adapted contrast remains a separate bounded diagnostic; the related factorial plan tests capacity and pretraining. Neither plan schedules the other automatically.
rationale: Separates encoder adaptation from the failed frozen-head pilot while removing its64-wide head bottleneck in both arms. The preferred128/256 by existing/assembly-targeted pretraining factorial remains a separate unexecuted plan requiring comparable histories and a shared decoder interface; this campaign does not estimate that factorial.
training_data_growth: Hold the authenticated70000-event corpus; this384-event development experiment is not a training-size comparison.
pretraining: No new pretraining; assembly-aligned representation learning is prioritized over simply extending unchanged pretraining or untested data growth.
